mechanic.instruct: A man in his sixties with a low, gravelly voice. Speaks slowly and dryly.
mechanic.ref_text: Hand me that wrench, would you? The one with the green tape.

clerk.instruct: A young woman in her early twenties with a light, quick voice. Overly polite and apologetic.
clerk.ref_text: I am so sorry to bother you, but I think this form is the wrong one.

announcer.instruct: A calm synthetic announcer voice. Smooth, precise and evenly paced.
announcer.ref_text: Good evening, and welcome aboard. Please keep all walkways clear.
